topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and HIPAA sanctions procedure; annual acknowledgment of POL-05
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (95%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk and SOC 2 readiness reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Billing services sit under the Director of Revenue Cycle, reporting to the CFO; security under the Director of IT and the vCISO; written role descriptions
evidence: Organization chart; role descriptions; Security Officer designation

control_description: Background checks at hire; annual security training; billing certifications tracked
gap: No role-based training for billing services staff on client data separation and payment change fraud
remediation: Role-based module for the 18 billing services staff

control_description: Performance reviews include policy compliance; sanctions applied and logged
Billing services data flows (client ePCR imports, claims, remittances, client reports) documented for the system description
gap: Data flows for 2 clients' imports are not documented
remediation: Complete the data flow diagram for all 4 clients

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies on the intranet; acknowledgments; monthly security reminders
Client agreements and BAAs set commitments; client contacts for incidents
gap: No system description or statement of service commitments; no written procedure for notifying clients of incidents
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; client notice procedure (POAM-021)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for billing services (timeliness, accuracy, confidentiality) stated in the risk appetite and client agreements
Annual risk analysis covers billing services (P01 R-012 to R-015, R-044, R-047)
Fraud risks considered in P01 (payment diversion, upcoding)
gap: No documented fraud risk assessment for billing services (remittance diversion, AI-assisted upcoding, insider changes to client fee schedules)
remediation: Fraud risk assessment with the CFO

control_description: Significant changes assessed through change tickets
gap: The AI coding module (AI-003) was enabled in 2025-11 without a risk assessment
remediation: Change risk checklist including the AI gate (STD-05)

control_description: Annual internal IT audit (P07); quarterly POA&M review
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected against P01 risks and documented in the SSP and this readiness matrix
General IT controls over endpoints, identity, and the billing platform configuration
gap: Configuration standard (STD-01) not issued
remediation: Issue STD-01 (POAM-009)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-16
gap: Billing services procedures (client onboarding, workspace setup, client offboarding) not written
remediation: Write the 3 procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Billing platform sign-in through the identity provider with MFA; client workspaces per client
gap: Workspace permission settings configured by the vendor and never reviewed by the company
remediation: Workspace permission review with the vendor (POAM-020)

control_description: Access requests approved by the Director of Revenue Cycle and created through the identity provider
evidence: Sample of 10 new billing users: all approved

control_description: Role-based access in the billing platform
gap: Access reviewed annually; all 18 billing services staff can open all 4 client workspaces
remediation: Client teams with workspace restrictions; quarterly reviews (POAM-001, POAM-020)

control_description: Badge access to the headquarters revenue cycle office; vendor data centers inherited
Certified destruction of retired devices

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Headquarters firewall; MFA for remote access; cloud hub controls
gap: No egress alerting; vendor remote access unmanaged elsewhere in the environment
remediation: Egress alerting and the vendor access broker (POAM-019, POAM-003)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Client reports sent through enforced email encryption or the platform portal
gap: 2 of 12 sampled client reports were sent as spreadsheet attachments without the encryption option
remediation: Send client reports only through the platform portal

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR in block mode on revenue cycle workstations; software installation restricted

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly patching of office endpoints; quarterly vulnerability scans
gap: Scans quarterly rather than monthly; configuration baselines not documented
remediation: Monthly scans (POAM-016); STD-01

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM monitors identity provider sign-ins to the billing platform
gap: Billing platform audit logs (workspace access, exports, configuration changes) not monitored
remediation: Send billing platform audit logs to the SIEM; quarterly workspace access review (POAM-007)

control_description: Incidents logged with discovery time and severity
gap: Decision log not yet used consistently for privacy incidents
remediation: Decision log in use (POAM-021)

control_description: P08 billing vendor breach runbook approved 2026-09-16
gap: Client notice procedure and templates not written; runbook not exercised
remediation: Client notice procedure; tabletop with 2 clients 2027-02-17 (POAM-014, POAM-021)

control_description: Vendor recovery plus company backlog procedures in P08
gap: Backlog and client communication procedures untested
remediation: Exercise in the 2027-02-17 tabletop

control_description: Change tickets for billing platform configuration
gap: Changes to coding rules, client fee schedules, and the AI coding module are made by 2 senior billers without a second approver or test
remediation: Change procedure with second approval and test for billing configuration

control_description: Vendor outage and breach workarounds in P08; credit line
gap: No secondary platform option evaluated
remediation: Evaluate a secondary platform or contract terms for extended outages

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: BAAs with the billing platform vendor (with client addendum) and other vendors; vendor SOC 2 reviews started 2026
gap: STD-03 not issued; mail vendor and cloud fax BAAs do not cover client PHI; vendor reviews began only in 2026
remediation: Issue STD-03; extend BAAs; annual Tier 1 reviews (POAM-017)

control_description: Platform capacity is the vendor's (SOC 2 Availability tested); billing staff capacity planned monthly against client volumes
Vendor backups and recovery infrastructure (inherited); company keeps weekly claim status exports per client
gap: Weekly exports are kept in a shared folder without retention or access restrictions
remediation: Move exports to a restricted location with retention

control_description: Vendor tests its own recovery annually (per its SOC 2 report)
gap: The company has never tested its own outage workarounds
remediation: Include in the 2027-02-17 tabletop and a live portal-submission test

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Client data classified Restricted (POL-04); kept in client workspaces
gap: Workspace separation not reviewed; client exports in a shared folder
remediation: Workspace review (POAM-020); restricted export location

control_description: Data returned or destroyed at contract end per client BAAs
gap: No documented procedure or certificate process for returning or destroying a client's data at contract end
remediation: Client offboarding procedure with destruction certificates

control_description: Processing objectives (claims submitted within 5 business days of a completed ePCR; accurate coding) set in client agreements
gap: Objectives not stated in a system description or measured monthly
remediation: Monthly service level report per client

control_description: Platform edits validate imported client ePCR records
gap: Import counts are not reconciled with client ePCR counts for 2 of 4 clients
remediation: Daily import reconciliation for all clients

control_description: AI coding module (AI-003) suggests level of service and diagnosis codes; coders review low-confidence suggestions
gap: About 35% of claims were coded straight through without human review; no accuracy monitoring
remediation: Stop straight-through coding; 100% coder review; monthly accuracy audit (POAM-022)

control_description: Claims, remittances, and client reports produced by the platform; monthly remittance reconciliation per client
gap: Client report errors corrected informally without a log
remediation: Error log and correction procedure

control_description: Claims data stored by the vendor; retention per client BAA
